findings: Original C filename API returns byte-identical first-frame RGBA for two independently checked two-frame GIFs whose second frames are green versus blue. Hash wrapper uses this API; animation-wide equality cannot be inferred.
Five TGA controls: top/bottom orientation and literal RLE agree with known pixels; changing horizontal descriptor bit leaves pixel order unchanged. Source handles vertical origin only.
PSD white-matte removal applies to partially transparent pixels; raw 16-bit output uses big-endian sample reads; compressed branch decodes byte RLE. No PSD runtime qualification.
HDR accepts -Y/+X layout and RGBE format; float decode then global gamma/scale byte conversion for wrapper. Full HDR metadata and colour-profile handling absent from wrapper recipe.

Keep earlier confirmed resize assertion failures, PNM16 endianness counterexample, JPEG h2 chroma counterexample, PNG/zlib integrity limitations, package omissions and source-only Zig lifetime/leak observations; no production code adopted.
